login.title: Sign in to Visitor Management
login.forgotHelp: Enter your username or email. We will email you a link to choose a new password.
login.resetHelp: Use at least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.
login.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
login.resetInvalidLink: This reset link is incomplete. Please request a new one.
login.faceHelp: Look straight at the camera with only your face inside the oval, then press Sign in with face.
login.faceNotRecognised: Face not recognised. Try again, or sign in with your username and password.
login.faceCameraError: Unable to access the camera. Allow camera permission, or sign in with your username and password.
login.heroTitle: Secure, modern visitor experience for your facility.
login.heroBody: Reception-ready workflows with check-in, passes, and live on-site visibility — built for tablets and desks.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company branding and visitor policy
settings.emailHelp: Configure the mailbox used for visitor thank-you emails and notifications. Choose a location to set location-specific SMTP (falls back to tenant default).
settings.smtpLocationHelp: Visitor emails use the visit location’s SMTP when configured; otherwise the tenant default.
settings.brandLocationHelp: Set a location-specific logo, theme, and company name. Falls back to the tenant default when not set.
settings.passLocationHelp: Each location can have its own pass number pool. Check-in uses the visit location’s series when configured; otherwise the tenant default.
settings.smtpPasswordHelp: Leave blank to keep the current password. Click Send test email after typing a new password — it will be saved automatically.
settings.smtpPasswordConfigured: A password is already saved. Type a new one here if login still fails, then send the test again.
settings.passSeriesHelp: Physical pass pool: set start–end (e.g. 6–10). Current is the last issued number (use start−1 before first issue). Codes look like {Prefix}{Year}-{number:D6}. After check-out, that number returns to the pool and is given to the next visitor (lowest free first).
